mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO rating (order_id, customer_id, ratee_id, rating_type, rating_value, comment, rating_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{rating.orderId}, #{rating.customerId}, #{rating.rateeId}, #{rating.ratingType}, #{rating.ratingValue}, #{rating.comment}, #{rating.ratingTime}, #{rating.createTime}, #{rating.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS customerName, r.rating_value AS ratingValue, r.comment AS comment, r.rating_time AS ratingTime FROM rating r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE r.rating_type = 'SERVICE' AND r.ratee_id = #{serviceId} ORDER BY r.rating_time DESC

SELECT mo.order_number AS orderNumber, s_order.service_name AS orderServiceName, r.rating_type AS ratedEntityType, CASE WHEN r.rating_type = 'DRIVER' THEN d.name WHEN r.rating_type = 'MOVER' THEN m.name WHEN r.rating_type = 'SERVICE' THEN s_ratee.service_name ELSE '未知对象' END AS ratedEntityName, r.rating_value AS ratingValue, r.comment AS comment, r.rating_time AS ratingTime FROM rating r JOIN moving_order mo ON r.order_id = mo.id JOIN service s_order ON mo.service_id = s_order.id LEFT JOIN driver d ON r.rating_type = 'DRIVER' AND r.ratee_id = d.id LEFT JOIN mover m ON r.rating_type = 'MOVER' AND r.ratee_id = m.id LEFT JOIN service s_ratee ON r.rating_type = 'SERVICE' AND r.ratee_id = s_ratee.id WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY r.rating_time DESC

SELECT r.id,
mo.order_number, c.name AS customerName,
r.rating_value AS ratingValue, SUBSTRING(r.comment, 1, 50) AS commentSnippet,
r.rating_time AS ratingTime,
r.order_id AS orderId FROM rating r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id JOIN moving_order mo ON r.order_id = mo.id WHERE r.ratee_id = #{currentDriverId} AND r.rating_type = 'DRIVER'
AND r.rating_value >= #{dto.minRatingValue}
AND r.rating_value <= #{dto.maxRatingValue}
AND r.rating_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}
AND mo.order_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.orderNumber}, '%')
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.customerName}, '%')
ORDER BY r.rating_time DESC

SELECT r.id,
r.rating_value, r.comment, r.rating_time,
c.name AS customerName, c.phone AS customerPhone, r.customer_id AS customerId,
mo.order_number, mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination, s.service_name AS serviceName, tt.type_name AS truckTypeName, mo.number_of_helpers AS numberOfHelpers, mo.moving_price AS movingPrice, r.order_id AS orderId FROM rating r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id JOIN moving_order mo ON r.order_id = mo.id JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id WHERE r.id = #{ratingId} AND r.ratee_id = #{driverId} AND r.rating_type = 'DRIVER'

SELECT r.id AS rating_id,
r.rating_value, r.comment, r.rating_time AS rating_time,
c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.phone AS customer_phone,
mo.id AS order_id, mo.order_number, mo.moving_origin, mo.moving_destination, s.service_name, tt.type_name AS truck_type_name, mo.number_of_helpers, mo.moving_price FROM rating r LEFT JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN moving_order mo ON r.order_id = mo.id LEFT JOIN service s ON mo.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN truck_type tt ON mo.truck_type_id = tt.id WHERE r.id = #{ratingId} AND r.ratee_id = #{moverId} AND r.rating_type = 'MOVER'
